content: Kiara Sen inquired about the renewal process for her health policy, which expired on December 10, 2026. Insurance agent Vikram Patel responded by apologizing for the inconvenience and providing a renewal form via attachment. Vikram instructed Kiara to complete and return the form by December 20, 2026.

action_items: Kiara Sen to fill out and return the attached renewal form by December 20, 2026
